description: Puts a site back to a version from list_versions - the undo button for AI edits. The current page is saved as a version first, so a restore can itself be undone. Free, and no account is needed for a draft you created. Version ids are reused once a page has 20 versions, so re-check list_versions before restoring an old id.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

page.description: Which page of the site, as its path ("/about", "/contact"). Omit for the home page. See list_pages.

site_key.description: The site to restore. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

version_id.description: The version to restore, from list_versions. The current page is saved as a version first, so a restore can itself be undone.

name: restore_version
title: Restore a saved version (undo)
